blocks.text: Condo buildings in North Meadows
District = SD42 Maple Ridge–Pitt Meadows.
The Fairways — 19673 and 19677 Meadow Gardens Way

A resort-style condominium complex on the edge of Meadow Gardens Golf Course, developed by Magusta Development, whose own portfolio page describes "an exclusive collection of 268 resort-style homes" built around a courtyard, with a Residents' Club overlooking the golf course offering exercise facilities, a massage space, a lounge and kitchen, and a games room. MLS listing records for units at both addresses record sub-type Apartment/Condo, subdivision name The Fairways, year built 2007, title to land Freehold Strata, and amenities including clubhouse, exercise centre, sauna/steam room, bike room, guest suite, caretaker and in-suite laundry; one listing records a new roof in 2022. Pet position is listing-level only: listings describe the complex as pet friendly, record "Cats OK", and one ground-floor listing states "one dog or up to two cats welcome".
Where the condos are and what to know

items.t: The closest official planning name for its southern edge is the North Lougheed Area (approximately 50 ha north of Lougheed Highway between Meadows Gardens Golf Course and Harris Road).

Where condo stock concentrates: it does not concentrate — there is one complex. The Fairways sits on Meadow Gardens Way at the edge of Meadow Gardens Golf Course on the sub-area's south edge; the rest of the sub-area is RS/RR houses and A-1/A-2 farm properties in the Pitt Polder.

Transit: the R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus stops at Harris Road on the south edge; route 701 runs via Harris Road and Hammond Road along the south edge to Pitt Meadows Station; route 719 serves Wildwood Crescent and Hammond Road. There is no West Coast Express station in this sub-area (Pitt Meadows Station is south of Lougheed Highway), and no bus route serving the rural north itself was confirmed.

Schools and catchments: SD42 catchments are address-based, and SD42 has no middle tier in Pitt Meadows (elementary K–7, then secondary). Highland Park Elementary, 18961 Advent Road, is physically in the sub-area; Pitt Meadows Secondary, 19438 116B Avenue, sits south of the sub-area.

Parks: Harris Road Park, 12474 Harris Road (concession, spray park, skate park, playground, walking trail, ball diamonds, outdoor pool, basketball court); Grabenhorst Garden, 13895 Harris Road; the Codd Island Wetlands, undiked floodplain wetlands on the Alouette River in the rural north, are on the City heritage register.

Health: the nearest hospital is Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street, Maple Ridge (24/7 emergency); the Ridge Meadows Urgent and Primary Care Centre is at 121-11900 Haney Place, Maple Ridge, open 9:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., 7 days a week. Pitt Meadows has no hospital.

Flood/ALR setting: over 95% of Pitt Meadows is in the floodplain per the City's 2020 Business Plan, protected by roughly 60 km of dikes, and this sub-area is the low Pitt Polder land drained by floodboxes and pump stations (Alouette Pump Station, Fenton and Pitt Polder catchments). Most of the city's land falls within the Agricultural Land Reserve.

"North Meadows" — styled "North Meadows PI" in the guide feed labels — is an MLS® sub-area name for the part of Pitt Meadows north of Lougheed Highway (Highway 7), covering the Highland Park and Wildwood residential areas, Harris Road north, and the rural Pitt Polder lands beyond; the City does not publish a boundary for it, and the closest official description is the North Lougheed Area, about 50 ha on the north side of Lougheed Highway between Meadows Gardens Golf Course and Harris Road.

Where the condo stock concentrates: one pocket only — Meadow Gardens Way, on the edge of Meadow Gardens Golf Course, where The Fairways stands. The rest of the sub-area's feed runs to large farm acreages on Richardson Road and Hale Road and boat-access-only cabins on Debeck Creek at Pitt Lake.

SD42 has no middle tier (elementary K–7, secondary 8–12) and catchments are address-based; the recorded locator run for 18961 Advent Road returned Highland Park Elementary and Pitt Meadows Secondary, plus French Immersion options.

Parks and anchors: Harris Road Park, 12474 Harris Road / 12474 Lougheed Highway (spray park, skate park, outdoor pool, diamonds); Grabenhorst Garden, 13895 Harris Road; Codd Island Wetlands on the Alouette River, on the City heritage register; heritage sites include the Japanese Canadian Hall, 19089 Advent Road, and the Pitt Meadows School House, 13414 Harris Road. No library branch is in this sub-area — the city branch is Pitt Meadows Public Library, 200-12099 Harris Road.
The board line on Advent Road cuts across the street. Anyone searching "55+ Pitt Meadows" by street will land on Advent Road; anyone searching by board sub-area will not find it under North Meadows.

Two near-identical names, two tenures, one street. Meadowland Village (18960 Advent Rd) is the buyable 55+ strata; Meadowlands Housing Co-operative (19032 Advent Rd) is a 55+ co-op where members hold shares and nothing is ever listed as a strata sale. Both are board-classed with Central Meadows and covered there.
The golf-course condos are the sub-area's only strata — and the count is not settled. The strata plan (BCS2427) and Form B are the documents that settle all three.

The rural north has no bus. Confirmed transit is all on the Lougheed/Harris south edge (R3, 701, 719); the Pitt Polder farm roads have no confirmed route at all, which matters for any buyer planning to age in place without driving.

The North Lougheed Area Plan is adopted but not built. OCP Amendment Bylaw No. 3060, 2026 covers roughly 50 ha north of Lougheed Highway, and the City states development will proceed gradually with further planning, studies and Council approvals.

items.t: The Advent Road school and the Advent Road 55+ pocket are in different sub-areas on paper. Highland Park Elementary stands at 18961 Advent Rd inside North Meadows, while the Meadowland Village / Meadowlands co-op pocket further along Advent Road is board-classified Central Meadows. Street name alone does not settle sub-area — the board label on the listing does.
The City's 2020 Business Plan states over 95% of the land base is in the floodplain. The 95% figure governs.

The Codd Island Wetlands are undiked. Unlike the diked urban and farm land around them, the Codd Island Wetlands on the Alouette River are undiked floodplain wetlands on the City heritage register — flood protection in the rural north is pump-and-floodbox drainage, not a uniform dike ring.
Rural servicing is a per-lot question. Well records can be checked in the provincial GWELLS application, and an onsite sewerage system must comply with the Sewerage System Regulation.

Taxes/rebates/financing: PTT 1% / 2% / 3% plus a further 2% on the residential portion above $3M — any "Over $3M — 5%" line combines the 3% and 2% rates. Exemptions: first-time buyers full on first $500,000 at ≤$835,000, partial to $860,000; newly built full to $1,100,000, eliminated at $1,150,000. Example (input: $662,500 community attached median, no exemption): $2,000 + $9,250 = $11,250. FTHB GST rebate (Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026 — never March 12): 100% to $1M, phasing to $1.5M, max $50,000, agreements Mar 20, 2025–2031; New Housing Rebate 36%, max $6,300, $350K–$450K phase-out; HBP $60,000; FHSA $40,000 / $8,000; CMHC premiums 0.6%–4.5%. GST on new construction, not resales (The Fairways is 2007 resale stock). Vancouver EHT does not apply.

MLS classes 18960 Advent Road (Meadowland Village, 55+) as Central Meadows while Highland Park Elementary at 18961 Advent Road — facing it — is in North Meadows. blocks.text: Acreage and rural land in North Meadows

What trades is fee-simple Pitt Polder farm and rural parcels under A-1 / A-2 agricultural zoning and RR rural-residential zoning, plus Highland Park and Wildwood house lots under RS / RR zoning — parcel by parcel, with no named acreage subdivision, no bare-land strata acreage community and no presale acreage offering verified on any source.
The ground in North Meadows

items.t: Agricultural parcels: A-1 General Agricultural — minimum lot area for subdivision 8 ha, one farm house per lot to a maximum gross floor area of 500 sq m; A-2 Large Lot Agricultural — minimum 16 ha.
Rural-residential parcels: RR-2 Large Lot Rural Residential minimum 4 ha; RR-3 minimum 2 ha; RR-4 minimum 1 ha.

Second dwellings on acreage: a garden suite is permitted in the A-1, A-2, RR-1 to RR-5 and RS zones, one per lot, 33 sq m to 90 sq m, and a property may have a garden suite OR a secondary suite, not both.

Well records can be checked in the provincial GWELLS application; an onsite sewerage system must comply with the Sewerage System Regulation and only an Authorized Person can design, install, repair, maintain or inspect it.

Not North Meadows stock: Meadowland Village + the Meadowlands Housing Co-operative on Advent Road are board-classified CENTRAL Meadows, not North Meadows, even though Highland Park Elementary at 18961 Advent Road, across the street, is in North Meadows.

blocks.text: Where the acreages are and what to know

items.t: Main streets: Lougheed Highway (south edge), Harris Road, Advent Road, Ford Road, McNeil Road and Old Dewdney Trunk Road, with agricultural Pitt Polder land to the north and east. Nearby areas: Central Meadows, Mid Meadows, South Meadows and West Meadows (same city), Maple Ridge across the Pitt River to the east, Port Coquitlam to the west. Search names: "North Meadows", "North Meadows PI", "Highland Park", "Wildwood", "Pitt Polder".

Transit and hazards in brief: R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus stops at Harris Road on the south edge; route 701 runs via Harris Road and Hammond Road; route 719 serves Wildwood Crescent and Hammond Road. The city is almost entirely protected by 60 km of dikes and its land base lies in the Fraser Valley floodplain; the Pitt Polder catchment is drained by floodboxes and pump stations.

Two near-identical names, two tenures, one street: Meadowland Village is the buyable 55+ strata; Meadowlands Housing Co-operative is a 55+ co-op where members hold shares and nothing is ever a strata sale. Both are Central Meadows stock, covered there — a North Meadows buyer will meet both names first.

Buildings in the farm zones sit back 15 m from water: Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011 requires residential and agricultural buildings to be sited 15 m from watercourses, key ditches and constructed ditches in the A-1 and A-2 zones — a buildable-envelope fact that changes what a Polder parcel can actually hold.

faq.a: Everything else in the sub-area is freehold houses and farm properties.
faq.q: How many condo buildings does North Meadows have?

faq.a: Settle the bylaw question from the strata's registered bylaws and Form B.
faq.q: Is The Fairways a 55+ building? It sits on a golf course and gets marketed to downsizers.

faq.a: Verify against the strata plan (BCS2427) before relying on any count.
faq.q: How many homes are in The Fairways?

faq.a: Long-term, yes — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been void since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC. Short-term rentals are different: Pitt Meadows prohibits STRs at the city level, a separate layer that the strata-law change does not remove.
faq.q: Can I rent out a Fairways unit?

faq.a: Yes — one. The Fairways (19673 and 19677 Meadow Gardens Way), a 268-home resort-style condominium complex by Magusta Development on the edge of Meadow Gardens Golf Course; unit listings record Apartment/Condo sub-type, built 2007, freehold strata.
faq.q: Is there really a condo complex in North Meadows?

faq.a: Listing-level evidence says yes: listings call it pet friendly, record "Cats OK", and one states "one dog or up to two cats welcome". Pet bylaws remain enforceable in BC, so the registered bylaws in the Form B package govern for a specific purchase.
faq.q: Are pets allowed at The Fairways?

faq.a: Only down to the zone minimums in Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011 — 8 ha in A-1 and 16 ha in A-2 — and, where the parcel is in the ALR, only with ALC approval; depositing a strata plan is itself a subdivision. Price no split before both frames are checked.
faq.q: Can I subdivide a farm parcel?

faq.a: A garden suite is permitted in the A-1, A-2, RR and RS zones, one per lot at 33 to 90 sq m (or a secondary suite, not both), and on ALR land the ALC also allows one additional detached residence to 90 sq m on properties 40 ha or less where the conditions are met.
faq.q: Can an acreage lot have a second dwelling?

faq.a: No — short-term rentals are prohibited in Pitt Meadows; STR accommodation is not a permitted use in the Zoning Bylaw. Do not price any parcel on STR income.
faq.q: Can I short-term rent the farmhouse or a cabin?

faq.a: Only if a pair was legally split — as a 2-lot strata plan or by fee-simple subdivision. Check title and plan before the form is believed.
faq.q: Can I buy half a duplex in North Meadows?

faq.a: Largely, yes to both on the City's current figures: Over 95% of Pitt Meadows is in the Fraser/Pitt floodplain behind 60 km of dikes, 78% of the city's land is in the ALR, and the northern Pitt Polder catchments drain by floodboxes and pump stations.
faq.q: Is North Meadows in a floodplain or the ALR?

faq.a: A garden suite is permitted in the A-1, A-2, RR and RS zones, one per lot at 33 to 90 sq m, and on ALR land the Agricultural Land Commission also allows one additional detached residence to 90 sq m on properties 40 ha or less where the conditions are met. Short-term rentals are a different answer: they are prohibited in Pitt Meadows — short-term rental accommodation is not a permitted use in the Zoning Bylaw.
